title: Leaving music for plastering; Georgie Parker with Johnny St. Cyr
summary: He left music for travel and plastering, but played about four years with the Georgie Parker band at Happyland and the lake with Johnny St. Cyr.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Because I got out the music business. I was so interested in traveling and plastering business.
That's why I lost a year I'm a plasterer. I guess you knew Johnny St. Cyr, did you? Good friend of mine.
I played music with him with Georgie Parker Band at Happyland and out the lake. We played there about four years.
When was that? That wouldn't be awfully long ago I guess. With Georgie Parker?
Well, that was in the late 40's.
